design: WAM-guided Hessian plugin: Gauss-Newton matrix of L = A + lambda Z + beta K turned into token/step and row weights of each Linear's Hessian; quantizer code untouched

smoke.scope: two C80 contexts (one diagnostic, one combined), a three-layer replay, one-layer GPTQ, one held-out BF16 endpoint with the swap; outputs only under results/smoke

loss.A: first10 x 6 motor MSE of the executed action (mean over 60 scalars)
loss.Z: future NMSE over frames 1: (frame0 is the clamped observation)
loss.K: mean per-scalar soft-bin KL(teacher || action read from the future by the BF16 reader); at the BF16 linearization point the reader is the model's own prefill + action loop

probes.contexts: C80 (case 2000-2079), sampler seed index 0, BF16 model
probes.cotangents: A: Rademacher/sqrt(60) on action[:10,:6]; K: Rademacher*sqrt(h/2), h = diagonal soft-bin KL curvature at the teacher action; Z: Rademacher/|z_T[:,:,1:]| on future[:,:,1:]
probes.reverse_passes: reader pass (prefill + action loop from the query's own future): v_A -> records prefill/action/proprio calls and gives c1 at z; v_K -> c2 at z (not recorded); query graph from z with c1 + sqrt(beta) c2 + sqrt(lambda) v_Z -> records video denoising calls
probes.diagnostic: on these contexts the three z cotangents are back-propagated separately (heads Az, K, Z); their sum replaces the combined pass

hessian.definition: H~ = sum_t (u_t / ubar_l + gamma) x_t x_t^T / sum_t (u_t / ubar_l + gamma) over every call of the 80 C80 queries; u_t = |g_t|^2 of the probe cotangent at the Linear output; ubar_l = layer mean of u over all its rows
hessian.format: results/hessians/<index>.pt with the A16-baseline prep keys (module, rows, hessian) plus weight_sum, ubar, gamma, row_weight (sum_t g_tc^2 |x_t|^2 per output row)

baseline.uses: results/prep/{modules.json, masters, hessians} (H_U) and methods/gptq/quant.py unchanged

evaluation.aggregation: seed -> context -> suite -> equal four-suite mean
evaluation.c1_swap: per query: the same quantized model's reader (prefill + action loop) reads the BF16 teacher future with the query's sampler seed

scope: S1 probes + S2 guided Hessians + GPTQ host (H_U vs H~) held-out; QTIP/GPTVQ hosts and closed loop use the saved Hessians in later jobs
